notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537740/Stick_Robot_Puzzle_Demo"][/dynamiclink]I've updated the demo version of StickRobotPuzzle.[/p]
[p]There are no changes to the puzzle content itself, but...[/p]
[list]
[*][p]Added "mysteries" to the world map (you'll be able to solve them in the full version)[/p][/*]
[*][p]Adjusted controls to feel more intuitive[/p][/*]
[*][p]Made the player robot feel more squishy[/p][/*]
[*][p]Added ambient sounds[/p][/*]
[*][p]Other minor changes[/p][/*]
[/list]
[p]...and more.[/p]
[p]The full version is almost complete and should be released in August![/p]
[p]HIKO[/p]

notes.title: Development Log – May 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p]

[h3]🗺 Progress on the World Map[/h3]
[p]The path from Stage 1 to the final stage on the world map is now complete!  
I'm currently adding a few hidden paths and making movement between stages a bit more convenient.  
I’d say it’s about 90% done.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005089/b967a8ca8c79d820bf25964761272b300295d268.png"][/img][/p]

[h3]🧩 Puzzle Stage Refinement[/h3]
[p]All puzzle stages are already complete, but I’m currently polishing up some elements—especially player guidance and overall feel—to make them smoother and more intuitive.[/p]

[h3]🎵 Asset Refinement (Especially the Music!)[/h3]
[p]The audio assets were made a long time ago when I first built a prototype of this game.  
I've finally started replacing and refining them—something that’s been on the to-do list for a while!  
It’s refreshing to hear the game with improved sound.[/p]

[h3]📅 Release Date Confirmed[/h3]
[p]I'm excited to announce that [b]StickRobotPuzzle will be released on August 1st, 2025 (Friday)![/b][/p]
[p]There’s still a chance the date may shift slightly, but this is the deadline I’ve set for now—and I’ll be doing my best to hit it.[/p]

[p]That’s all for now. Thanks again for your continued support![/p]

[p]🛒 Check out the store page here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846550/Stick_Robot_Puzzle/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you for checking out the game!

The demo has been updated.

[b]While the stages themselves haven't changed, a world map has been added, allowing you to move around the world as part of the puzzle.[/b]

In addition, a Linux version is now available!
[b]It works on Steam Deck.[/b]

We hope you enjoy it!
